# External Integrations

**Analysis Date:** 2026-03-09

## APIs & External Services

**Content API (auto-generated by Payload):**
- REST API - All collections exposed at `/api/{collection-slug}` via `@payloadcms/next` route handler at `src/app/(payload)/api/[...slug]/route.ts`
- GraphQL API - Auto-exposed at `/api/graphql` and `/api/graphql-playground`
- Custom collection endpoint - `GET /api/nitf_posts/nearby` (geospatial proximity query via PostGIS, implemented in `src/lib/nearby.ts`)

**No third-party external APIs detected.** No Stripe, Cloudinary, SendGrid, or similar service SDKs are present in `package.json` or source imports.

## Data Storage

**Databases:**
- PostgreSQL 16 with PostGIS 3.4 extension
  - Connection: `DATABASE_URL` env var (connection string format)
  - Client: Drizzle ORM via `@payloadcms/db-postgres`
  - Migrations: managed explicitly in `src/migrations/` (auto-push disabled: `push: false` in `src/payload.config.ts`)
  - PostGIS extension enabled in `src/migrations/20260303_214307_add_postgis.ts`
  - Spatial index on `nitf_posts.geom` (SRID 4326, geometry(Point))
  - Raw SQL via Drizzle `db.execute(sql`...`)` used for geospatial queries in `src/lib/nearby.ts`

**File Storage:**
- Local filesystem — uploads stored under `/app/media` in the Docker container
- Media collection configured at `src/collections/Media.ts` with `upload: true`
- `sharp` 0.34.2 used for server-side image processing/resizing

**Caching:**
- None detected

## Authentication & Identity

**Auth Provider:**
- Payload built-in auth (JWT-based, cookie sessions)
  - Users collection at `src/collections/users/Users.ts` with `auth: true`
  - Roles stored in JWT: `admin`, `editor`, `user`
  - Role checking utility: `src/collections/users/access/checkrole.ts`
  - Access control functions:
    - `src/collections/users/access/anyone.ts` - public access
    - `src/collections/users/access/user.ts` - authenticated users (self or admin/editor)
    - `src/collections/users/access/editor.ts` - editor/admin only
    - `src/collections/users/access/admin.ts` - admin only
  - Role protection hook: `src/collections/users/hooks/protectRoles.ts`

**No external OAuth / SSO providers detected** (no NextAuth, Auth0, Clerk, etc.)

## CI/CD & Deployment

**Hosting:**
- Docker container; target platform not specified in workflows (assumed self-hosted or any Docker-compatible host)
- Container image: `ghcr.io/{github-repository}:latest` and `ghcr.io/{github-repository}:{sha}`

**CI Pipeline:**
- GitHub Actions
  - `docker-publish.yml`: triggers on push to `master`; builds Docker image and pushes to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) using `docker/build-push-action@v6`
  - `publish-types.yml`: triggers on push to `master` when `src/collections/**`, `src/payload.config.ts`, or `packages/types/**` change (also `workflow_dispatch`); generates Payload types and publishes `@basecamp-cms/basecamp-cms-types` to npm
  - No automated test runs in CI pipelines detected

**Container Registry:**
- GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) — authenticated via `GITHUB_TOKEN` (built-in secret)

**npm Registry:**
- `registry.npmjs.org` — public package `@basecamp-cms/basecamp-cms-types`; authenticated via `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` (must be set as GitHub repo secret)

## Webhooks & Callbacks

**Incoming:**
- None detected (no webhook endpoint handlers)

**Outgoing:**
- GPX file self-fetch: `NitfTrails` collection fetches GPX files from its own server URL (using `PAYLOAD_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL`) in an `afterChange` hook to parse trail statistics (distance, elevation gain/loss, bounding box)

## Environment Configuration

**Required env vars:**
- `DATABASE_URL` - PostgreSQL connection string
- `PAYLOAD_SECRET` - CMS session secret (min 32 chars)
- `PAYLOAD_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL` - Base URL for self-referencing hooks (e.g. `http://localhost:3000`)

**Secrets location:**
- `.env` file (local, not committed)
- GitHub Actions secrets for CI: `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` (npm publish), `GITHUB_TOKEN` (GHCR, built-in)
